from dag import topo_sort
assert topo_sort({'b': ['a'], 'c': ['a'], 'd': ['b', 'c'], 'a': []}) == ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']
try:
    topo_sort({'a': ['b'], 'b': ['a']})
    assert False, 'expected cycle ValueError'
except ValueError:
    pass
